title: Tier 1
body_html:
Lumi XL is our way of bringing together the most exciting coffees currently in Luminous into one large format bundle tiers designed for people who want to explore, share, group buys for worldwide cost savings, coffee shops, retail and if you just want to stock up. This is our wholesale model made for the public whats been always behind closed doors for shops . No nonsense and made for you Lumi's. This will be a very spastic model and has no dates it just happens. very limited quantities and bundles are set!

Tier 1 bundle includes twelve 200-gram boxes across three coffees. These are the same coffees featured across the Lumi XL tiers and are selected to showcase different processing styles and profiles. this bundle is a 35% discount off of retail pricing in the Dropstore.

What’s Included

Mexico La Joya Lot 44 Natural
4 × 200g boxes

Colombia Orange Blossom Co-Ferment
4 × 200g boxes

Ethiopia Halo Washed
4 × 200g boxes

Total Coffee:
12 boxes × 200g
2.4 kg of coffee in total
